# Repository map

- `src/credit_fraud/config.py`: immutable validated TOML configuration.
- `src/credit_fraud/data.py`: CSV loading and fraud-dataset schema validation.
- `src/credit_fraud/modeling.py`: stratified split, fold-local sampling, tuning, metrics.
- `src/credit_fraud/artifacts.py`: predictions, metrics, and safe model persistence.
- `src/credit_fraud/service.py`: dependency-injected application orchestration.
- `src/credit_fraud/cli.py`: thin command-line entry point.
- `config.example.toml`: runnable configuration template.
- `tests/`: deterministic offline unit and pipeline tests.
